claim_limit: This record preserves a public author-deposited Gazepoint GP3 source candidate. The Figshare record names the GP3, a visual-search gaze-event-detection study, original raw Gazepoint files, anonymized human data, and an MIT licence for the deposit. It does not establish collection-specific native sampling cadence, independent expert/manual fixation or saccade labels, annotation protocol/adjudication, participant-disjoint benchmark readiness, human-human agreement, or any GazeForge native-device performance or validity claim.
dataset: Gazepoint GP3 manuscript code and data
fingerprint_method: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for this object with evidence_fingerprint_sha256 omitted, sort_keys=true and separators=(',', ':').
next_authoritative_gate: Inspect the deposited raw/data/code archives without altering them and fingerprint the obtained files.
Verify sampling cadence from the actual recorded timestamps rather than device-name assumptions.
Determine whether any event-reference stream is independently human/expert annotated rather than vendor- or algorithm-generated.
If manual labels exist, recover the event taxonomy, annotator identities/roles, annotation instructions, adjudication/blinding, and exact source-to-canonical column mapping.
Only after those checks may an empirical native evidence specification be considered; dataset_status must otherwise remain template.
